[quote=the_crystalline_empire;61539285][b]March 20, 2028: Barbarism[/b]

Following a recent decision by the EDU to embargo, sanction, and order the seizure of all Vespurian assets within the Commonwealth of Vespurias, the government of Rosenmarkke, responding to actions taken by the government of the United Lavian Republic would announce that it would be putting back into full force dictat D-12, revised earlier in February, which would bar businesses from participating in trade with the EDU or EDU aligned states, with orders for the National Bureau of Trade to investigate and freeze the assets of any EDU aligned company or any company doing business with the EDU in Rosenmarkke. 

The Council of 99 would call the actions by the EDU, following the re-implimentation of D-12, Economic cowardice, and would further re-iterate its demands to Wuloosya, to, Call back its hounds.

[/quote]

[b][u]The Government Responds[/u][/b]

The government of President Fereydun Khan of Dhornaper condemns the unjustified seizure of Dhora assets in Rosenmarkke.

Dhornaper has not been involved in the war between Neue Republik and Wuloosya against Rosenmarkke and does not intend to involve itself in active hostilities. The government of President Fereydun Khan of Dhornaper calls on the government of Rosenmarkke to walk back its unneeded and unjustified sanctions and refrain from making enemies with neutral states.

[b][u]Dhora Corporations in Rosenmarkke Respond[/u][/b]

An appeal against the seizure of Dhora assets has been lodged on behalf of all Dhora companies by a consortium of the largest Dhora companies operating in Rosenmarkke. It reads as follows:

1. Dhornaper has remained consistently neutral in the ongoing conflict. Per international law, none of Dhornaper's actions constitute hostilities with Rosenmarkke. Furthermore, incorporation in Dhornaper does not automatically qualify Dhora companies operating in Rosenmarkke as necessarily hostile.

2. No evidence has been supplied that would substantiate the treatment of Dhornaper and Dhora companies as actively engaged in undermining Rosenmarkke or aiding its enemies. Commercial interactions presently can continue with Rosenmarkke corporations still able to do business in Dhornaper. Only Rosenmarkke has seized Dhora assets.

3. The seizure of assets was executed without notice or opportunity for exemption or appeals. This fundamentally falls short of internationally expected due process. Blanket seizure of assets has eroded trust with the Rosenmarkke government and Dhora companies. Future business is likely to be conducted with great trepidation.

4. The seizure of assets, per the arguments in 1 to 3, are disproportionate and unjustly punishes companies of a neutral state, adversely affecting our operations in Rosenmarkke. Hundreds of workers in Rosenmarkke, the vast majority Rosenmarkke citizens themselves, will face an uncertain future as our businesses cannot operate under such circumstances. The lack of consideration of alternative measures has not provided comfort or relief to workers who face job losses and corporations that face being forced out of Rosenmarkke.

5. We appeal on these grounds and urge the Trade Courts to lift the misguided seizure of Dhora assets.

[i][u][b]Official Statement from the Government of the United States of Oceanica[/b][/u]

The Government of the United States of Oceanica affirms to the international community that the actions of the ULR authorities to freeze the assets of the United States of Oceanica on the territory of Lavian are an unjustified aggression against Oceanica.

Currently, the Oceanica government has no stance on the actions of EDU, nor has it made any decision on the current situation between EDU and Vespurias.

For the time being, the Oceanica government will not take any action or intervene in the current conflict between EDU and Vespurias. We will remain neutral on the matter as long as the situation doesnt escalate. We call on EDU and Vespurias to communicate with each other and resolve the conflict peacefully.

The Oceanica government also requests that the Lavian government immediately remove the freeze on the assets of the United States of Oceanica. The actions of the ULR authorities to freeze the assets of the United States of Oceanica are unjustified aggression, especially since the Oceanica government has not taken any aggressive actions. The actions of the ULR authorities to freeze the assets of the United States of Oceanica are against international norms.

The Oceanica government was never notified of the plans of EDU to take action against Vespurias. The Oceanica government has never participated, agreed to, or supported the plans of EDU to take action against Vespurias.[/i]

The National Trade Court of Rosenmarkke, holds no objection to the implementation of policy exemption under the later revisions of the D-12 framework. [b]A Statement on the Affairs of Rosenmarkke, Wuloosya, and the White Strait[/b]
[i]From Her Majesty Elena, Queen of the Revolutionary Kingdom and Absolute Monarchy of Koranvistan, her Districts, and her Territories[/i]:
"Regarding recent events surrounding the White Straight, I feel it necessary to express, in full, the aims of the Kingdom. My first loyalty is and always will be to the people here, to the stability of our nation, and securing a place for our children in the future. Today, on behalf of my people, I iterate and affirm, in full, our stance to the international community:

Trade, not just with the Vespurians, but with the whole of the Corridor, has been vital to the rehabilitation of our Motherland. Shall Vespurias be cut off? And thereby, Koranvistan from her root? The Kingdom refuses to comply with the orders against the Vespurians.

I see this war as it is: too many decisions made in haste. Fools with weapons, vying for a supremacy which [i]even if won,[/i] will come at too great a loss.

The Rosenmarkket people have every right to dictate their nation how they please, and we denounce the use of "democratic process" to justify a violent interventionism that threatens to pull us all in.

We denounce the actions of Wuloosya and the Neue Republik, who aren't fighting a war that started this year, but are escalating a grudge we have no business in.

We reaffirm our stance that a full and immediate ceasefire is the best course of action, and we stand willing to aid in peace. Should we find our actions disrespected, we will find ourselves standing elsewhere."

In other news, the Koranvistani Military announces the finished construction of a new fleet carrier (the KSS Helene), a new helicopter carrier (KSS Ioranth), and the addition of 4 new missile cruisers. The Military and Royal Guard have been conducting military exercises off the coast, around the Massanikoan islands, and in the Akr territory.

[i]The Republic of Daesun is appalled by the United Lavian Republic's deliberate use of primitive tactics to "de-escalate" the situation, which has only brought about the  proliferation of tensions in the area. The nation's seizure of Daesunite assets, and vend to the hostile rogue state that is the Socialist Republic of Rosenmarkke is an escalation deemed unacceptable by the Republic of Daesun, and shall be met with thorough retaliatory action. As a state with self-declared neutrality in the Wuloosyan-Rosenmarkkett war, Daesun officially [b]condemns[/b] the United Lavian Republic for forcing her into a crisis she did not wish to be part of. 

All Lavian and Rosenmarkkett assets within Daesunite markets, or markets associated with the [url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2743488]P.E.C.A.[/url] shall be unreservedly seized by the Hanean Economic Council and redistributed to reinvestment relief funds for crisis-control. Additionally, Daesun shall employ a 20% baseline tariff on all Lavian goods, while also implementing successive tariffs on certain goods such as an 45% tariff on aircraft, 60% tariff on latex, and a final 100% tariff on Lavian petroleum.  

The United Lavian Republic shall be officially re-designated as a state sponsor of terrorism, as a subsequent action of its undeniable attempt to cause harm to Daesunite citizens economically. The Lavian embassy in Daesun shall be seized for the time being, and ambassadors are to be expelled from the country, while Daesunite ambassadors within Lavia will also vacate the state to Oceanica and Valonia. 

The Republic of Daesun will also seek the proliferation of its military presence in Western Argos to deter any further aggressive Lavian action to terrorize EDU member states and/or neutral countries, total servicemen deployments in Oceanica shall be bolstered from 15,000 to 28,000, and from 1,500 to 5,000 in Valonia. [nation]The Commonwealth Provisional States[/nation]

Monday, 28 February, 2028: Elena at the Assembly

Following repeated attempts by the Governors to usurp Crown powers, Elena called an emergency meeting of the Assembly under a call to order. Early on Monday morning, she strode coolly into the Assembly Hall after all of the Governors. She took her seat, organized her papers quietly, and stood.
[i]A new constitution. One that would render me ineffective in my Kingdom. One that would strip our government of its function and would instead bestow powers to bad faith actors.

Let me tell you all, now, why that wont stand. Because out of us in this room today, four had guns in their hands and dirt on their faces with me during that war we fought. And they werent elected, I chose them to rule alongside me. Because,[/i] she cleared her throat and eyed the governors, holding the draft constitution in view.

[i]none of them would sign off on this. They understand the way this works, see. That you represent your constituents to me, and I get it done. Put it to vote. It wont pass, and if it does- well, the time for talking will be over, no?[/i]

Alder Bruzhnikkoyya stood, face red with rage, [i]Well have the force to meet you. Youre not much more than a child, and a gun at the right time doesnt change that. This should have been the way, not an assumption of what your ilk think to be order![/i]

She sifted through her papers again, meeting his anger with silence. [i]Sit down, governor. It would be wise to withhold your threats from now on, and Ill let it slide. You see, governor, it wasnt just the gun that was in my hand, and it wasnt just the patch on my vest,[/i] She walked closer to him, standing toe to toe, or as close as she could get,

[i]It was an understanding that the Revolution doesnt simply end with a new face in charge, or with a new flag. Because there a structures from the old guys, yanno? Little roots that havent been pulled, weeds in the garden that want to grow into oppression again.

And the Revolution doesnt stop until that job is done, yanno?[/i] she narrowed her eyes, pulling a gun from her belt and setting on the table in front of Bruzhnikoyya. [i]Because the Revolution isnt over until her enemies are dead. The Revolution isnt over until the last weed has been pulled and Governor Bruzhnikoyya?[/i]

[i]The Revolution doesnt stop until the old systems are taken out back and shot. The Revolution isnt over until the old systems stop twitching,[/i]

She waved her hand and reholstered her gun. The room was tense and quiet.

And traitors like you stop twitching with them. Meeting adjourned.
